QuestInfo.name: Mercedes's Token of Heroism
QuestInfo.0: The Great Spirit has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: The Great Spirit has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.2: The Great Spirit gave you an emblem.

0.0: Ruler of the Elves... I can sense that your power has grown enough to stand against the darkness. I wish to lend my strength to this cause.

no.0: What a shame... Return to me if you change your mind.

yes.0: The Ruler of the Elves someone of unmatched might... but this era has strewn thorns across your path. I hope this humble gift can ease the way.
